name: iterative-refinement
description: Disciplined, measurable iteration for a substantial refinement or investigation: loop against verifiable pass/fail conditions, fan work out to subagents, and keep the main context lean. Use when improving something measurable over repeated cycles (tuning a metric or detector, refactoring against a regression bar), chasing a surprising or suspicious number, or driving a long multi-step task where delegation and context discipline matter. Not for one-shot edits or quick lookups that don't warrant a loop.
